story.title: City Chronicles
story.subtitle: In 2099, Earth's ecology collapsed, and Professor Gu passed away in the Qinling Mountains. On January 1, 2100, Project 'Wuyi' was launched, and 2048 'Chosen Ones' left Earth to carry out the mission of civilization continuity. Carrying the concept of 'Symbiotic Homeland', they rebuilt a society where humans and nature coexist in harmony under extreme conditions.
